asset_generation_jobs_target_check.name: asset_generation_jobs_target_check

market_listings_evidence_check.name: market_listings_evidence_check

market_products_price_check.name: market_products_price_check
market_products_price_check.value: "market_products"."price" is null or ("market_products"."price" >= 0 and "market_products"."currency" is not null)

        when 'project' then "ops_kill_switches"."project_id" is not null and "ops_kill_switches"."target" is null
        else "ops_kill_switches"."target" is not null
      end

ops_policies_limits_check.name: ops_policies_limits_check
ops_policies_limits_check.value: coalesce("ops_policies"."cash_limit_per_job_minor", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("ops_policies"."cash_limit_per_day_minor", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("ops_policies"."cash_limit_per_month_minor", 0) >= 0 and "ops_policies"."max_concurrent_jobs" >= 0 and "ops_policies"."max_posts_per_account_per_day" >= 0 and "ops_policies"."post_cooldown_minutes" >= 0 and coalesce("ops_policies"."wip_limit", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("ops_policies"."operator_minutes_per_week", 0) >= 0

ops_release_authorizations_basis_check.name: ops_release_authorizations_basis_check
ops_release_authorizations_basis_check.value:
case "ops_release_authorizations"."mode"
        when 'human_approval' then "ops_release_authorizations"."approved_by" is not null
        else "ops_release_authorizations"."policy_id" is not null and "ops_release_authorizations"."approved_by" is null
      end

ops_tasks_lease_check.value: ("ops_tasks"."status" = 'claimed') = ("ops_tasks"."lease_actor_id" is not null and "ops_tasks"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "ops_tasks"."lease_actor_type" is not null)

ops_usage_events_cost_check.name: ops_usage_events_cost_check
ops_usage_events_cost_check.value: ("ops_usage_events"."cost_status" = 'unknown') = ("ops_usage_events"."cost_minor" is null) and ("ops_usage_events"."cost_minor" is null or ("ops_usage_events"."cost_minor" >= 0 and "ops_usage_events"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'))

publish_intents_verified_check.name: publish_intents_verified_check

publish_posts_title_check.value: "publish_posts"."title" is null or length(btrim("publish_posts"."title")) between 1 and 200

publish_readings_correction_check.name: publish_readings_correction_check
publish_readings_correction_check.value: "publish_readings"."supersedes_id" is null or "publish_readings"."correction_reason" is not null

quote_clients_tax_check.name: quote_clients_tax_check
quote_clients_tax_check.value: "quote_clients"."tax_id" is null or length(btrim("quote_clients"."tax_id")) between 1 and 40

quote_quotes_issued_check.name: quote_quotes_issued_check
quote_quotes_issued_check.value: ("quote_quotes"."sent_at" is null) = ("quote_quotes"."issued_on" is null) and ("quote_quotes"."issued_on" is null) = ("quote_quotes"."valid_until" is null)
